content_sections.heading: About University of Lucknow
content_sections.text: The University of Lucknow is the host of this project, which runs in its Department of Anthropology. The project was awarded under ICSSR (2025-26) and comes under the scheme of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). Its title is "Indigenous Maternal and Child Healthcare practices and Health-Seeking Behavior among the Raji Community in Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh: An Anthropological Study".

content_sections.text: Graduate in any Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. A four-year undergraduate degree/program Prior fieldwork experience See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Field Investigator
content_sections.text: Fieldwork and data collection (primary and secondary) Data compilation, analysis and report writing Assistance in project-related academic activities

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview in the Department of Anthropology, University of Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The period of appointment is 6 months, on an ICSSR-funded project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for University of Lucknow Field Investigator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your C.V. Email it to the Project Director at [email protected] on or before the last date. Attend the walk-in interview at the Department of Anthropology, University of Lucknow, at the time given above. Documents to carry to the interview: Original documents One set of self-attested photocopies

faq.question: Q1. Is a four-year undergraduate degree compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: No. A four-year degree or program is only a preference, as is prior fieldwork experience. The mandatory requirement is graduation in any Social Science discipline with at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q2. Who receives the applications?
faq.answer: The C.V. goes to the Project Director, Dr. Soni Verma, Assistant Professor, Department of Anthropology, University of Lucknow.

faq.question: Q3. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q4. Which community does the project study?
faq.answer: The project looks at indigenous maternal and child healthcare practices and health-seeking behaviour among the Raji Community in Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q5. What kind of data work does the job involve?
faq.answer: Selected candidates collect both primary and secondary data, then compile and analyse it and write reports.

faq.question: Q6. What time should I reach the interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview on 18 November 2026 is held at 11:00 AM.
